field: pick field = any racer not on the card; it wins when the official winner is not on the card
longShot: Solo picks pay the most: a new pick on a racer nobody has picked pays 400 right now
scoring: right pick scores round(100 × (all picks + carried-in picks) ÷ picks on the winner); a race nobody calls rolls its picks into the next card (last 3 cards max); picks are sealed until close
